style.prompt: Bright, friendly educational animation of the water cycle over a sunny lake and green hills, widescreen. Three stages in order. 0-3s: the sun warms the lake and wavy wisps of water vapor rise upward; bold clean white caption at the bottom reads exactly "Evaporation". 3-6s: the vapor gathers high in the sky and puffy white clouds form and grow; caption changes to exactly "Condensation". 6-10s: the clouds turn gray and rain falls onto the hills and lake; caption changes to exactly "Precipitation". Only one caption visible at a time, no other text, letters, logos or watermarks anywhere. Audio: a warm, friendly narrator voice-over says: "The sun warms the water, and up it rises as vapor. That is evaporation! High in the sky, the vapor cools into clouds. That is condensation. When the clouds get heavy, down comes the rain. Precipitation!" Soft cheerful background music and gentle rain sounds at the end.
